construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch in the isolated build directory

shared_schema.input: Version 1 envelope: schema_version=1, optional fixture_label, documents array, nonempty fields array, optional unique target-name array. Unknown configuration keys are rejected.
shared_schema.documents: Each document has a unique nonblank id, format (records, csv, key_value), and embedded content. Records content is an array of objects; other content is text.
shared_schema.fields: Each field declares exact source key, unique target key, type (string, integer, number, boolean); optional required, default, trim, min, max, pattern, choices. No nested-path interpretation.
shared_schema.output: Version 1 envelope: status (ok or needs_review), fixture_label, records [{document_id,row,data,valid}], issues [{document_id,row,field,code,message}], summary {documents,records,valid_records,issues}. Rows are one-based extracted record ordinals.
shared_schema.errors: Invalid input/configuration, document structure, JSON, or files produce {schema_version:1,status:error,error:message}, exit 2. Data-quality issues produce needs_review and exit 0.
shared_schema.validation: A shared validation layer validates all formats and mapping configuration before extraction; the same conversion and field checks apply to every extracted record.

cross_stage_handoffs: Source dictionaries -> typed target dictionaries with document and row lineage
Target dictionaries -> field checks, global per-field uniqueness checks, issue list and summary
behavior: Deterministic document, record, field and issue ordering; no clock, randomness, I/O writes or provider calls in implementation.
CSV supports quoting and rejects duplicate/blank headers and inconsistent widths. Headers and source keys are exact.
Key-value text uses the first colon, strips keys and values, skips blank lines, rejects duplicate keys.
Default applies only when a source key is absent; explicit null or empty text remains missing. Optional missing values become null.

Trimming defaults to true. Integer conversion accepts integers or integer strings, never booleans or fractional values. Number conversion rejects nonfinite values. Boolean conversion accepts booleans or case-insensitive true/false strings.
Patterns are full matches; numeric bounds are inclusive. Each uniqueness target is checked independently across all documents, skipping missing and unconvertible values.
Checks retain converted out-of-range values for review; conversion failures yield null. Unmapped source keys are omitted. No records are silently discarded due to quality issues.

included: Typed validation and data quality checks
excluded: PDF, DOCX, OCR and image extraction

test_outcomes.cli_example: passed: exit 0, one JSON object, status ok, 3 documents, 4 valid records, 0 issues
coverage: CLI validation, file, usage and JSON errors
